personalInfo.name: Ashraf Ayman
personalInfo.title: GIS Software Developer
personalInfo.about: I build GIS software, from ArcGIS web apps and spatial APIs to location-intelligence workflows. My work sits at the intersection of geo-informatics, web development, and .NET, and I care about shipping tools that help people see and act on spatial data.
personalInfo.goal: I want to grow as a GIS developer in a team that values technical depth and the chance to keep learning.

honors: Honours in GIS and Remote Sensing, 2021

projects.title: esri-Library (APIs)
projects.subtitle: Dynamic GIS library for enterprise solutions
projects.description: An API library on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript for building enterprise GIS web apps with spatial analysis, drawing, and data storage.
projects.longDescription: I built an Esri library on the ArcGIS API for JavaScript for Gulf Terminal. The library takes a structured data object and exposes functions that display, draw, or store spatial data and support other spatial workflows. Core widgets ship by default, and additional widgets can be added as needed.
features: Database integration and spatial data storage

projects.title: COP27, Sharm El-Sheikh
projects.subtitle: Real-time green-area monitoring
projects.description: GIS and remote-sensing work for COP27: pan-sharpened satellite imagery and a web app to monitor Sharm El-Sheikh’s green areas.
projects.longDescription: Geospatial tools can show whether sustainability work is actually landing. For COP27 we used Hexagon solutions to track Sharm El-Sheikh’s green initiatives. I pan-sharpened satellite imagery to about 10 cm resolution and built a GIS web app so teams could read oxygen and carbon dioxide levels over time and catalogue newly planted trees.
features: Oxygen and CO2 tracking over time

projects.title: Geowarehouse Solutions
projects.subtitle: Spatial analysis for warehouse management
projects.description: ITI final project: a GIS business web app for warehouse coverage, customer patterns, and branch decisions.
projects.longDescription: A GIS-based business application for warehouse decisions, built as the ITI final project with Ahmed Ashraf, Ahmed Mesbah, and Shady Mamdouh. It analyzes spatial data over time so operators can see service coverage, customer patterns, delivery demand, and where a new branch might make sense. The stack was ArcGIS Enterprise (Online, Portal, Server) with Esri APIs and standard web technologies.

projects.title: Clustering
projects.subtitle: Point clustering visualization
projects.description: A learning project on FeatureReductionCluster for dense point layers in the ArcGIS API for JavaScript.
projects.longDescription: A learning project on point clustering with the ArcGIS API for JavaScript. FeatureReductionCluster groups nearby features and sizes symbols by count, which cuts clutter in dense point layers. I also built a FeatureLayer from client-side features, including the schema the API requires.

projects.title: City Filtering
projects.subtitle: Regional city data visualization
projects.description: An ArcGIS web app that filters world cities by region, with class-break renderers, charts, and map widgets.
projects.longDescription: A learning project that maps world cities and filters them by region. It uses class-break renderers, esriRequest, and charting libraries, plus legend, measurement, and basemap gallery widgets.
